## Change

Describe the problem, intended behavior and supported protocol scope.

## Evidence

List commands actually run and results. Include meaningful negative/resource-bound
cases and independent peer evidence when changing transport behavior. State any
unavailable gate explicitly. Keep default checks local and free of provider credentials.

## Provenance and compatibility

- [ ] Newly authored code, or pinned upstream file licenses and notices recorded in `docs/provenance.md`.
- [ ] Runtime/build/test dependency changes and complete graph accounted for separately.
- [ ] Public API or wire behavior changes explained; relevant docs updated.
- [ ] No secrets, private media, provider credentials or unrelated generated files included.
